zh.intro: 1907 年 10 月，美国没有今天的美联储，也没有联邦存款保险。纽约信托公司吸收存款、向市场放贷，却不都能得到银行清算组织的支援。这里的“信托公司”是当时的金融机构，不能直接套用今天某个理财产品的定义。

steps.title: 导火索：铜业股票投机失败
steps.text: 10 月 16 日，United Copper 的股票操纵企图失败。人们担心相关人物控制或关联的银行也有损失，开始取走存款。

steps.title: 恐慌扩散：为什么大家一起取钱？
steps.text: 存款人未必能查清机构资产，只知道“别人正在取钱”。Knickerbocker Trust 管理层与投机者的关系引起担忧；10 月 22 日，挤兑迫使它暂停营业。

steps.title: 传导：银行问题怎样影响企业？
steps.text: 机构需要现金应付取款，于是减少向券商和企业放贷。证券融资更难，卖资产换现金又可能压低价格，形成信用收缩。

steps.title: 救助与后来改革
steps.text: J.P. Morgan 协调私人资金支援部分机构和市场，清算组织也采取救助。依赖临时协调暴露制度缺口，危机推动货币改革讨论；美联储是在 1913 年依法成立，不是 1907 年当天出现。

zh.example: 教学假设：一家机构有 100 元资产，其中 90 元是不能马上收回的贷款、10 元是现金。如果储户同时要取 30 元，即使贷款最终能收回，它今天也可能缺现金。这叫流动性压力；资产总价值已不足偿债才是另一类问题。
zh.pitfall: Knickerbocker 是暂停营业，后来于 1908 年重开，并非从此永久消失。“救急现金”与“弥补资产损失”也不能混为一谈。

en.intro: In October 1907 the US had neither today’s Federal Reserve nor federal deposit insurance. New York trust companies took deposits and made loans, but many lacked clearinghouse support.

steps.title: A failed speculation
steps.text: An attempt to corner United Copper stock collapsed on October 16. Depositors questioned institutions associated with the speculators.

steps.title: Withdrawals spread
steps.text: Connections between Knickerbocker Trust’s leadership and the speculators undermined confidence. A run forced Knickerbocker to suspend operations on October 22.

steps.title: A wider credit squeeze
steps.text: Institutions needed cash for withdrawals. Reduced lending disrupted securities financing and business credit; asset sales could intensify the pressure.

steps.title: Emergency support, then reform
steps.text: J.P. Morgan coordinated private assistance for parts of the system. Reliance on emergency coordination encouraged monetary reform. The Federal Reserve was established by law in 1913, not during the panic itself.

en.example: Illustration: an institution with $100 in assets, including $90 in slow-to-repay loans and $10 cash, may be unable to meet $30 in immediate withdrawals even if its loans are ultimately sound.
en.pitfall: Illiquidity is not automatically insolvency. Knickerbocker suspended operations and reopened in 1908; it did not simply vanish permanently.

zh.intro: 熊市 Put 价差（Bear Put Spread）用于表达“在指定期限内看跌”的想法。Put 是按执行价卖出标的的权利。组合用一条买入 Put 获得下跌敞口，再卖出更低执行价 Put 减少成本，代价是盈利封顶。

steps.title: 先认清两条腿
steps.text: 同一标的、同一到期日、等数量：买较高执行价 Put，卖较低执行价 Put。下述全部是假设教学报价，不是当前可交易合约。

steps.title: 例子：买 100 Put，卖 95 Put
steps.text: 假设买入每股付 5，卖出每股收 3，净付 2。标准乘数假设为 100，一组初始支出是 200 美元。两张不同期权合起来才是一组价差。

steps.title: 为什么涨跌都会有边界？
steps.text: 到期时，100 Put 的价值为 max(100−股价, 0)；95 Put 是卖出的，所以要减去 max(95−股价, 0)。再扣每股 2 的成本。股价跌到 95 以下，两腿的价值差始终是 5。

steps.title: 怎样理解开仓与退出？
steps.text: 在模拟券商中识别“买入看跌价差”：买入开仓高执行价 Put，同时卖出开仓低执行价 Put，检查净支出。平仓时反过来：卖出平仓长腿、买回平仓短腿。不同券商用词和组合成交方式可能不同。

steps.title: 到期前不能照搬到期表
steps.text: 尚未到期时两腿还有时间价值，价格也受 IV 和流动性影响。方向看对也可能尚未盈利；提前平仓看组合实际成交差价，而不是只看一条腿。

zh.example: 最大理论到期亏损 = 净支出 × 100 = 200 美元；最大理论到期利润 = (100−95−2) × 100 = 300 美元；盈亏平衡股价 = 100−2 = 98。以下到期表假设双腿按组合正确处理，均未计费用。
zh.pitfall: 卖出的美式 Put 可能提前被指派，产生接收股票与资金需求；长腿不会因为短腿被指派就自动替你处理。到期附近还可能留下意外股票仓位。组合理论亏损上限不等于无需管理交割。

en.intro: A bear put spread expresses a bearish view over a specified term. A put grants the right to sell at its strike. Selling a lower-strike put offsets some of a purchased put’s cost, but caps the payoff.

steps.title: Two legs, one position
steps.text: Use the same underlying and expiration, with equal quantities: buy the higher-strike put and sell the lower-strike put. All prices here are invented teaching assumptions.

steps.title: Build a 100 / 95 example
steps.text: Pay $5 per share for the 100 put and collect $3 for the 95 put. Net debit: $2. With an assumed 100-share multiplier, one spread costs $200.

steps.title: Calculate the expiration result
steps.text: Per-share profit = max(100−S, 0) − max(95−S, 0) − 2. Below $95, both puts have intrinsic value and their difference stays $5.

steps.title: Opening and closing in a simulator
steps.text: Identify a put debit spread: buy to open the higher strike, sell to open the lower strike, and verify the net debit. Closing reverses both legs. Broker terminology and execution vary.

steps.title: Before expiration
steps.text: Time value, IV and liquidity still affect prices. An early exit uses the actual spread sale price; the expiration table is not a quote for today.

en.example: Assuming both legs are handled together, before fees: maximum expiration loss $200, maximum profit $300, breakeven underlying price $98.
en.pitfall: An American-style short put can be assigned early, creating stock and funding obligations. The long put is not automatically exercised to handle that assignment. Expiration can also leave unintended stock exposure.

zh.intro: 2008 年危机不只是股市下跌。房贷损失、证券化、金融机构融资和企业信贷相互连接。

steps.title: 从房贷到证券
steps.text: 一些房贷被汇集成抵押贷款支持证券，再出售给投资者。房贷违约增加时，损失与估值疑虑会影响持有人。

steps.title: 从损失到融资压力
steps.text: 资金提供者担心机构能否偿还，减少短期贷款；机构被迫卖资产，压力扩散。2008 年 9 月 Lehman 申请破产，是重要节点而非唯一原因。

zh.example: 假设机构用 5 元自有资本加 95 元借款买 100 元资产。资产跌 5 元，就可能耗尽这 5 元资本；资产只跌 5%，对资本却是巨大冲击。
zh.pitfall: 区分资产损失、缺现金与股价下跌；也不能把所有救助都当成同一种工具。

en.intro: The 2008 crisis linked mortgage losses, securitization, funding markets and business credit.

steps.title: Mortgages became securities
steps.text: Mortgages were pooled into securities. Rising defaults damaged cash flows and made valuations uncertain.

steps.title: Funding amplified the shock
steps.text: Lenders pulled back short-term funding. Forced asset sales added pressure. Lehman’s September 2008 bankruptcy was a major milestone, not the only cause.

en.example: If $5 of equity and $95 of borrowing fund $100 of assets, a $5 asset loss can wipe out the equity. A small asset decline becomes a large capital loss.
en.pitfall: Asset losses, cash shortages and stock-price declines are different. Rescue tools also served different purposes.

zh.intro: 1929 年股市崩盘与大萧条有关，但大萧条是持续多年的经济危机，不是一根暴跌 K 线。

steps.title: 先有股市冲击
steps.text: 1929 年 10 月股市剧烈下跌，影响投资者财富与信心。

steps.title: 再看后续传导
steps.text: 此后的银行恐慌、信用收缩与政策问题让经济困境加深。企业融资、生产和就业会相互影响。

zh.example: 假设居民因资产缩水减少消费，商店收入下降；银行又减少贷款，企业就更难维持生产和雇人。这说明金融冲击怎样进入日常生活。
zh.pitfall: 不要只用一个交易日解释整个萧条；“股市反弹”也不代表经济已经全面恢复。

en.intro: The 1929 crash and the Great Depression are related, but the depression was a prolonged economic crisis.

steps.title: The initial market shock
steps.text: The October crash damaged wealth and confidence.

steps.title: The later transmission
steps.text: Banking panics, contracting credit and policy problems deepened the downturn, affecting production and employment.

en.example: Imagine households cut spending after losses while banks restrict loans. Shops lose revenue and businesses struggle to finance hiring.
en.pitfall: One trading day cannot explain the entire depression. A market rebound need not mean a complete economic recovery.

zh.intro: 挤兑是许多储户集中要求取回存款。银行把一部分钱放成长期贷款，通常不会把所有存款都留成柜台现金。

steps.title: 先看时间不匹配
steps.text: 储户可以马上取钱，但贷款要慢慢收回；资产可能有价值，却不能立即变现。

steps.title: 恐慌如何自我强化
steps.text: 担心取不到钱的人先来提款，迫使机构筹现金；其他人看到排队，更想先取。

zh.example: 有 10 元现金、90 元贷款，却突然要支付 30 元取款：今天缺 20 元现金，不必然意味着全部资产只值 10 元。
zh.pitfall: 流动性不足是“现在付不出”；资不抵债是“资产价值不足以偿债”。两者可能相互影响，但不是同义词。

en.intro: A bank run means many depositors demand cash together. Deposits fund loans as well as cash reserves.

steps.title: Different clocks
steps.text: Withdrawals may be immediate; loan repayment takes time.

steps.title: A feedback loop
steps.text: Fear triggers withdrawals; withdrawals force cash-raising; visible stress encourages more withdrawals.

en.example: $10 cash plus $90 loans may not meet $30 in immediate withdrawals even if the loans are sound.
en.pitfall: Illiquidity means a current cash shortage; insolvency means insufficient asset value to cover obligations.

zh.intro: EPS 是“每股盈利”，先把公司属于普通股股东的利润，除以这一期间的加权平均普通股数。它不是你会收到的分红。

steps.title: 为什么看加权平均？
steps.text: 年中发行或回购股票，只影响部分时间的股数；不能随便拿年末股数代替整个期间的分母。

steps.title: 稀释后为什么可能更低？
steps.text: 潜在新增股份可能分摊利润。稀释 EPS 的具体计算还需按会计规则处理相关利润调整与反稀释项目。

zh.example: 简化假设：利润 100 美元、平均 50 股，EPS = 2 美元。利润不变、股数变为 100 股，EPS = 1 美元。比较 EPS 时也要看利润与股数各自变化。
zh.pitfall: 回购可能提高 EPS，但不证明总利润增长；会计利润也不等于经营现金流。

en.intro: EPS divides earnings attributable to common shareholders by weighted-average common shares. It is not a dividend payment.

steps.title: Why average shares?
steps.text: Shares issued or repurchased partway through a period affect only part of that period.

steps.title: Why dilution matters
steps.text: Potential extra shares may spread earnings more thinly. Accounting rules also govern numerator adjustments and anti-dilutive instruments.

en.example: Simplified: $100 earnings / 50 shares = $2 EPS; with unchanged earnings and 100 shares, EPS is $1.
en.pitfall: Buybacks can lift EPS without growing total profit. Earnings and operating cash flow are different.

zh.intro: Delta 衡量标的价格小幅变化时，期权报价大约变化多少。它是局部、随时会变的敏感度。

steps.title: 先确认单位
steps.text: 标准股票期权报价通常按每股显示；一张合约的变化还要乘实际合约乘数。

steps.title: 再确认方向
steps.text: 持有 Call 的 Delta 通常为正，持有 Put 通常为负；卖出仓位的敞口符号反过来。

zh.example: 假设 Call Delta = 0.40，股票上涨 1 美元，其他条件不变，报价近似上涨 0.40 美元；乘数 100 时一张约增加 40 美元。
zh.pitfall: 大幅波动时 Delta 会改变；时间和 IV 也影响报价。Delta 不是实际盈利概率。

en.intro: Delta estimates the premium response to a small underlying-price move. It is a changing local sensitivity.

steps.title: Check units
steps.text: A per-share premium change must be multiplied by the actual contract multiplier.

steps.title: Check direction
steps.text: Long calls usually have positive delta; long puts negative delta. Short positions reverse that exposure.

en.example: At 0.40 call delta, a $1 stock rise suggests about $0.40 more per share, or $40 with a 100 multiplier, other factors unchanged.
en.pitfall: Large moves change delta. Time and IV also matter; delta is not your actual probability of profit.

zh.intro: Gamma 衡量 Delta 怎样随标的价格改变。如果 Delta 是当前速度，Gamma 就描述速度变化。

steps.title: 为什么临近到期要留意？
steps.text: 临近到期、接近平值的期权，Delta 可能对小幅价格变化非常敏感。

steps.title: 组合需要合并计算
steps.text: 买入与卖出的期权可有相反的 Gamma 敞口，要看全部腿而非只看买入的那张。

zh.example: 假设 Call Delta 为 0.40、Gamma 为 0.08，股票上涨 1 美元后，Delta 局部近似变为 0.48；这是敏感度估计，不是固定承诺。
zh.pitfall: Gamma 也会变化，不能用一次近似无限外推；高敏感度也意味着仓位可能快速偏离原计划。

en.intro: Gamma measures how delta changes as the underlying moves.

steps.title: Near expiration
steps.text: Near-the-money options can become especially sensitive to small price moves.

steps.title: Use the whole position
steps.text: Long and short legs can have opposite gamma exposures.

en.example: If call delta is 0.40 and gamma 0.08, a $1 stock rise locally suggests delta near 0.48, other factors unchanged.
en.pitfall: Gamma changes too. Do not extend a local approximation indefinitely.

zh.intro: Theta 描述剩余时间减少时，期权理论报价的变化。期权还有多久到期，会影响市场为未来可能性付多少钱。

steps.title: 不等于每天固定扣费
steps.text: Theta 是模型敏感度，会随价格、IV 与到期距离变化。

steps.title: 方向对也可能亏
steps.text: 标的缓慢朝预期方向走，带来的价格收益可能小于时间价值减少或 IV 下跌的影响。

zh.example: 假设报价 3 美元、Theta = −0.04，其他条件不变，一天时间减少的局部估计是每股约 −0.04；乘数 100 时约 −4 美元。
zh.pitfall: 不能把当天 Theta × 剩余天数当成精确损失。组合卖出腿也可能抵消部分时间敞口。

en.intro: Theta estimates the premium change as time to expiration decreases.

steps.title: Not a daily bill
steps.text: It is a model sensitivity, changing with price, IV and time remaining.

steps.title: Direction alone is insufficient
steps.text: A slow favorable stock move may be outweighed by lost time value or lower IV.

en.example: At a $3 premium and −0.04 theta, one day less time locally suggests about −$0.04 per share, or −$4 with a 100 multiplier, other factors unchanged.
en.pitfall: Today’s theta multiplied by every remaining day is not an exact forecast.

zh.intro: IV（隐含波动率）是从期权价格反推的波动输入，不是对涨跌方向的预测。事件前的不确定性可能让期权更贵。

steps.title: 为什么事件后会压价？
steps.text: 财报公布后，一部分未知变成已知，IV 可能下降；这会影响期权价格。

steps.title: 同时看三个变化
steps.text: 标的方向、时间流逝和 IV 变化共同影响持仓，不要只看股价是否上涨。

zh.example: 假设你买 Call 后股价上涨，方向给报价带来 +0.30，但 IV 下跌带来 −0.50，时间变化带来 −0.05，简化合计仍是 −0.25。这里只用于说明因素叠加。
zh.pitfall: 事件后 IV 不保证下降，也不能把高 IV 解读成“股票一定大涨”。

en.intro: Implied volatility is inferred from option prices. It concerns modeled movement size, not a predicted direction.

steps.title: After an event
steps.text: Resolved uncertainty can lower IV and option premiums.

steps.title: Track multiple inputs
steps.text: Underlying price, time and IV affect the position together.

en.example: Illustration: +$0.30 from direction, −$0.50 from IV, −$0.05 from time gives a simplified −$0.25 total.
en.pitfall: IV need not fall after every event. High IV does not guarantee an upward stock move.

zh.intro: RSI 把近期上涨与下跌的相对力度压成 0–100 的指标。它描述已经发生的动量，不知道下一根 K 线。

steps.title: 先看周期
steps.text: 14 周期 RSI 在日线看 14 根日 K，在 5 分钟图看 14 根 5 分钟 K，时间跨度不同。

steps.title: 再看环境
steps.text: 常见 70 / 30 阈值只是参考。在强趋势中，RSI 可以长期停留在较高或较低区域。

zh.example: 假设股价持续抬高，RSI 处于 75；这不等于“下一刻必须下跌”。需结合趋势、价位与明确失效条件理解。
zh.pitfall: “超买”不是自动卖出指令；一个指标也不能单独证明入场胜率。

en.intro: RSI summarizes recent upward versus downward momentum on a 0–100 scale.

steps.title: Check the timeframe
steps.text: Fourteen daily bars and fourteen five-minute bars cover different spans.

steps.title: Check the regime
steps.text: Common 70 / 30 reference levels are not automatic reversal triggers; strong trends can remain stretched.

en.example: A stock making higher highs with RSI 75 need not fall on the next bar.
en.pitfall: Overbought is not an automatic sell instruction or a measured win rate.

zh.intro: ATR 是平均真实波幅：测近期价格通常波动多大，包含跳空带来的变化，不预测涨跌方向。

steps.title: 为什么不只看日内高低？
steps.text: 高低价差会漏掉相对前收盘的跳空。真实波幅还比较本期高 / 低与前收盘的距离。

steps.title: 怎么读数值？
steps.text: ATR 通常与价格同单位，比较不同价格的股票时，还可看 ATR ÷ 股价的比例。

zh.example: 假设前收盘 100、今日最高 106、最低 104。日内范围只有 2，但真实波幅是 max(2, 6, 4) = 6；向上跳空被算进来了。
zh.pitfall: ATR = 6 不代表明天一定涨或跌 6，也不保证按某个 ATR 距离设置止损就一定成交。

en.intro: ATR averages true range, a measure of movement size that includes gaps, not direction.

steps.title: Why include the prior close?
steps.text: High minus low alone misses overnight gaps.

steps.title: Read the units
steps.text: ATR is generally in price units. ATR / price helps compare differently priced instruments.

en.example: Prior close $100; high $106; low $104. True range = max(2, 6, 4) = $6, despite a $2 intraday range.
en.pitfall: An ATR of $6 does not predict tomorrow’s direction or guarantee stop execution.

zh.intro: CPI 衡量城市消费者一篮子商品和服务的价格变化。先确认数据的时期、单位与口径，再解释数字。

steps.title: 同比和环比不是一回事
steps.text: 同比比较上年同月，环比比较上月。核心 CPI 排除食物与能源，整体 CPI 包含它们。

steps.title: 判断公布值要有参照
steps.text: 前值、修订值与有来源的市场预期分别回答不同问题；没有共识来源时，不能自己编“超预期”。

zh.example: 教学假设：整体 CPI 同比 3%、核心环比 0.3%。这不是两个同口径数字，不能直接说 3 比 0.3 高十倍所以更糟。
zh.pitfall: 通胀增速下降不等于物价水平下降；市场反应还取决于事前定价、增长与利率环境。

en.intro: CPI measures changes in prices of a consumer basket. Check period, unit and definition before interpreting it.

steps.title: Year-on-year versus month-on-month
steps.text: They compare different periods. Core CPI excludes food and energy; headline CPI includes them.

steps.title: Choose the comparison
steps.text: Previous values, revisions and sourced consensus answer different questions. Missing consensus is not permission to invent a surprise.

en.example: Hypothetical headline inflation of 3% year-on-year and core inflation of 0.3% month-on-month are not directly comparable.
en.pitfall: Slower inflation is not necessarily falling prices. Market response also depends on prior pricing and broader conditions.
